description: Commands that change the plan (§6.2), its conditions and search (§6.2.1), and derived columns (§6.2.2).

cases.description: Plan commands give no requests and leave the session as it is.
Plan commands write plan even when it becomes {}.
With add, an ascending key turns descending in its place.
The parts of the new where follow the search, in one and.
The conditions of the column are replaced in the place of the first one.
A condition that also refers to another column is not a condition of the column.
The search keeps its text as it is given.
A text that trim leaves empty removes the search.
A derived column sees only the derived columns before it.
The new name goes to the plan, styles, the setting, the session's cells and checked.where.
The renamed setting replaces a setting of the new name.
In an aggregated view, d in sort and the setting names the measure d, which keeps its name.
b uses a, so both go, with the parts of where, the sort keys and the settings that use them.
An aggregate left without keys and measures goes, with having.
Sort keys that do not validate against the groups are removed.
The parts of having and the sort keys that use the measure s go.
